applicant.name: Dr. Katharina Moser
applicant.organisation: Austrian Hospital Planning Office, capacity planning

purpose: We plan cardiology bed capacity for the next hospital structure plan.
question: How many inpatient stays had heart failure as the main diagnosis in 2025 in each hospital and how long did they last on average?
definitions: Heart failure stay = inpatient stay whose main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starts with I50.
Count stays (not patients) whose start_date is in 2025, attributed to the hospital (data_holder) of the stay.
Length of stay = end_date minus start_date in days.
Report per hospital: heart failure stays and the mean length of stay in days, one decimal.
